g.text: merged sources, deduplicated; 31,691 dated wild-bird events (domestic poultry flock outbreaks — n=2,250 events, 208.5M birds — mammals & undated records excluded; ISO-week reports dated to mid-week). Wild Galliformes (quail, pheasant, wild turkey) account for only 1.4% of events — the order's apparent prominence before exclusion was domestic poultry. Panel d: only sources reporting per-event bird counts (WHISPERS, WAHIS, GISAID avi-list, UK DEFRA, Ireland); most surveillance sources count single birds. Top 9 orders shown, remainder as 'Other'.
